SELECT CREATETIME, T.CONCLUSION, T.SUGGEST, T.APPLYDESC, T.USERID, T1.EMPNAME || '(' || T.USERID || ')' AS USERNAME, T1.MOBILETELPHONE TEL, (SELECT LOCATION FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE TO_CHAR(DEPID) = T.DEPTNO) AS DEPTNAME, ISFALSE FROM PPM_NEWFLOW_LOG T LEFT JOIN PPM_EMP_VIEWALL T1 ON T1.BADGE = T.USERID WHERE T.FLOWCASENO = #{flowcaseno} AND T.ISDEL = '0' ORDER BY T.CREATETIME ,T.ID ASC

SELECT DISTINCT a.* FROM ( SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE ADMINID = ( SELECT ADMINID FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '013') UNION ALL SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '011' UNION ALL SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE ADMINID = ( SELECT DEPID FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '011') UNION ALL SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE ADMINID IN ( SELECT DEPID FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE ADMINID = ( SELECT DEPID FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '010')) UNION ALL SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE ADMINID = ( SELECT DEPID FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '010') UNION ALL SELECT DEPID, depcode, LOCATION, compid, DEPGRADE FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = #{deptId} AND DEPGRADE = '010' ) a ORDER BY a.DEPGRADE
